title: Auto Mission I Auto Boss I Auto Shikai I And More
features:
**Main:**
* Auto Farm Mission
* Auto Skip Shinigami Mission
* Auto Rejoin If Mission Bugged
* Select / Farm Selected Mobs
* Auto Farm All Mobs
* Freeze Mobs
* Void Mobs
* Auto Open Lootbox
* Auto Loot
* Server Hop If No Loot
* Auto Shikai
* Auto Equip Weapon
* Auto M1 / M2 / Critical
* Auto Pop Shikai / Bankai
* Auto Use Skills (1–9)

**Bosses:**
* Auto Kill Jidanbo + Server Hop
* Auto Kill Bawabawa + Server Hop
* Auto Kill Ayon + Server Hop
* Raid Bosses (Coming Soon)

**Combat:**
* Target Player / Refresh / Clear / Auto Target
* PvP Distance / Position (Under, Near, Above)
* PvP Auto M1 / M2 / Critical / Grip
* Auto Use Skills (Combat)
* Auto Parry (Manual / Smart)
* Parry Distance / Reaction Delay / Hold Duration / Cooldown
* Parry Players / NPCs toggle

**Teleport:**
* Teleport To NPC
* Teleport To Area
* Rejoin / Server Hop / Copy Job ID / Join By Job ID
* Auto Rejoin By Job ID
* Teleport Bypass

**Visuals (ESP):**
* ESP Mobs + Names
* ESP NPC + Names
* ESP Players + Names / Race / Rank / Grade / CharName / Health
* ESP Divisions / Bounty Boards / Mission Boards / Traders

**Misc:**
* Noclip
* Infinite Jump
* Anti-AFK
* No Camera Shake
* Auto Grip On Kill
* Bypass Frozen
* Global Stop

comments.text:
- Added Pass/Ranked Farm
- Added Auto Collect Pass Rewards
